title: US seeks to revive Russia-Ukraine talks as Russian strikes kill seven in Kyiv
body:
On 25 September 2026, Al Jazeera, citing Reuters, reported that the United States was working to arrange a new round of talks to end the war. Kyiv and Moscow both confirmed plans to relaunch trilateral talks, which had stalled while Washington was engaged in its war on Iran. The United Arab Emirates was proposed as host. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said the US had suggested a technical-level, three-way meeting and that Kyiv was awaiting a proposed date. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said a trilateral meeting could happen soon. US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner had visited Russia and Ukraine earlier in September.

Overnight, Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said at least seven people were killed in Russian strikes on the capital, including a 14-year-old boy, and another 46 were injured. Ukraine's air force said it downed 267 of 295 Russian drones launched overnight. ArcelorMittal said it was halting production at Ukraine's largest steel plant after four strikes in five weeks killed five workers.

Ukraine struck refineries in Moscow and Yaroslavl. Zelensky said Trump told him Ukraine would be permitted to produce advanced Patriot missiles, and EU members agreed to release 7.5 billion euros from the European Peace Facility, according to EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas.
